verdict.rationale: Warp ships a built-in agent that takes natural-language task descriptions and carries them out, from writing code and running commands to driving interactive apps and iterating until done. It supports multi-turn conversations, follow-ups, prompt queueing and parallel conversations. Users confirm they delegate real work to it, such as sysadmin over SSH and finding and assessing unused files. Recent reports of agents stopping and random failures are a reliability caveat, not a refutation. Missing for 10: independent evidence of consistent reliability on delegated tasks, given recent user reports of agent failures and quality drops.
